description_detailed: 2024 celebrates the 35th anniversary of The Little Mermaid. Its release in theaters marked the beginning of the second golden age of Walt Disney Studios in 1989. Limited to 500 copies, this miniset features the three new 10, 20 and 50 centime denominations in Brilliant Uncirculated (BU) quality.This set contains all 8 French circulating denominations in Brilliant uncirculated (BU) quality. The €1 coin is minted exclusively for Miniset and proof quality series and will not be minted in circulating quality in 2024.
